title: Awesome Python
summary: A broad, curated index of Python libraries, tools, and frameworks.
description: Organized by domain, from web frameworks and data tools to testing and DevOps. Use it for discovery, then check a project's maintenance status before adopting it.

title: Python Cheatsheet by gto76
summary: A dense single-page reference covering the language, standard library, and idioms.
description: A comprehensive cheat sheet for quick lookups: types, comprehensions, formatting, file handling, concurrency, and more. Best for people who already know the basics and want one page to search.

title: Finxter Python Cheat Sheets
summary: A large library of printable Python cheat sheets for syntax, libraries, and interview prep.
description: Finxter collects compact sheets for beginners and intermediate developers, covering syntax, data structures, pandas, regex, and common interview topics. Useful for printing or keeping open beside an editor.

title: Real Python Cheat Sheets
summary: Downloadable cheat sheets for Python basics, libraries, and common workflows.
description: Real Python's collection covers syntax, regex, pandas, virtual environments, and more. Many sheets are free with an email signup, and the visual format works well for printing.

title: Scientific Python Cheat Sheet
summary: A compact reference for NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, and scientific Python workflows.
description: A printable cheat sheet aimed at scientific computing: arrays, linear algebra, plotting, and common NumPy operations. Useful when moving from pure Python to notebook-based analysis.

title: Visual Studio Code
summary: A fast, extensible editor with first-class Python and Jupyter support.
description: Visual Studio Code pairs a large extension ecosystem with a solid Python experience: linting, debugging, testing, notebooks, and remote development. A pragmatic default for most Python work.

title: Cursor
summary: An AI-first code editor built on VS Code with inline editing and chat.
description: Cursor adds model-assisted edits, codebase chat, and agent workflows to a familiar editor. Useful for exploration and refactors, but review generated changes as carefully as any other code.
